calls.statement:
WITH p AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS e)
SELECT
 count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS all_active,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.store_id<>999 AND pr.category<>'ZZ Test' THEN m.member_id END) AS excl_test,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 OR pr.category='ZZ Test' THEN m.member_id END) AS test_touch,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.status='cancelled' THEN m.member_id END) AS cancelled_touch,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 OR f.net_amount<=0 THEN m.member_id END) AS nonpositive,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN m.member_id END) AS staff,
 min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date), count(*) AS lines
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product pr ON pr.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND f.channel_code='WB'
CROSS JOIN p
WHERE f.sale_date > p.e - 364 AND f.sale_date <= p.e

WITH p AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS e)
SELECT
 count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND m.member_key IS NULL) AS orphan_member_keys,
 count(DISTINCT m.member_id) FILTER (WHERE w.status='cancelled') AS cancelled_members,
 count(DISTINCT m.member_id) FILTER (WHERE s.store_id=900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL) AS web_no_order,
 count(DISTINCT m.member_id) FILTER (WHERE m.valid_from > p.e) AS future_version_members
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND s.store_id=900
CROSS JOIN p
WHERE f.sale_date > p.e - 364 AND f.sale_date <= p.e AND f.member_key IS NOT NULL

calls.statement:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT r.fiscal_year, r.fiscal_period, r.period_end_date AS as_of_end
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar r
  WHERE r.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND r.fiscal_period = 8
),
active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  CROSS JOIN p
  WHERE f.sale_date > p.as_of_end - 364 AND f.sale_date <= p.as_of_end
)
SELECT p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_period, cur.tier, COUNT(*) AS active_members
FROM active a
CROSS JOIN p
JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id = a.member_id AND p.as_of_end BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to
GROUP BY p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_period, cur.tier
ORDER BY CASE cur.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
